title: The least prime with a given primitive root and a variant of the larger sieve
summary: For an integer $g$ not equal to $-1$ or a square, we study the least prime $p_g$ such that $g$ is a primitive root modulo $p_g$. We show that, assuming the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis, all such $g$ with $|g|\in[N,2N]$ have $p_g\leq(\log |g|)^{3.44}$ with at most $O((\log N)^{2.44})$ exceptions. This can be directly compared to the uniform bound $p_g\leq(\log |g|)^{19}$ proven recently by Fan and Pollack.
